candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment to betLimit so the state variable is never updated.
Replace `betLimit = amount;` with `betLimit = amount + 1;` causing the stored value to differ.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call AdjustBetAmounts.
Replace the require condition with `true` so onlyOwner no longer restricts access.
Delete the state variable update `difficulty = amount;` so the modifier no longer persists the new difficulty.
Replace `difficulty = amount;` with `difficulty = amount + 1;` so the stored difficulty is always one higher than requested.
Replace `difficulty = amount;` with `difficulty = amount - 1;` so the stored difficulty is always one lower than requested (except when amount=0).
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` statement from the `onlyOwner` modifier, allowing anyone to call `AdjustDifficulty`.
Replace assignment to openToPublic with assignment to false instead of true.
Delete the body of OpenToThePublic so the state variable openToPublic never changes.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from OpenToThePublic so anyone can call it, changing who can alter openToPublic.
Replace onlyOwner modifier logic to always revert, preventing openToPublic from ever being set to true.
Replace onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender == whale instead of owner, blocking real owner from opening.
